title: CAN WE PREDICT ALIGNMENT BEFORE MODELS FINISH THINKING? TOWARDS MONITORING MISALIGNED REASONING MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on predictive safety monitoring for reasoning language models, specifically detecting whether a model will produce a safe refusal or an unsafe (harmful) response. It uses technical safety benchmarks like HarmBench and SORRY-Bench to evaluate monitoring methods but does not engage in evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethical frameworks.
